sinopsis.es: Un encuentro entre amigos se convierte en una experiencia que altera su realidad y transforma sus relaciones.
sinopsis.en: A hybrid queer short film that follows three friends during a weekend at a cabin in the rural area of Medellín. After spending time at a nearby river, the group arrives at their retreat in the middle of the forest, immersing themselves in a deep psychotropic ritual of love and desire. This experience alters their reality and ends up fracturing their relationship, evoking fragments and scraps of their shared memories. In this trance, a radical transformation is unleashed when they summon, together, a mysterious creature born from within themselves. Through their bodies and visual memory, a mutation occurs that pushes them to escape into the forest during the night. The next morning, each one leaves the cabin on their own, now living in a world where their friendship no longer exists.
